clue.text: Legal scholar curtailed hazard in project

indicators.note: the word 'in' places the shortened hazard inside the word for project

explanation.surface: A legal academic sees danger in some cut-back scheme.

explanation.definitionFit: A scholar of law, a writer on jurisprudence, is the classic sense of the word.

clue.text: So occupied by muscle condition in particular

clue.text: Mineral surveyor's conclusion amid rising criticism being fine
